**Current behavior**
<!-- Describe how the bug manifests. -->
Console error on bootstrap. Error message is below. Error is shown when components have an empty href binding in the code, ie `[href]=""`.

Error message:
`zone.js?1478627523524:355 Unhandled Promise rejection: Cannot read property 'currValExpr' of null ; Zone: <root> ; Task: Promise.then ; Value: TypeError: Cannot read property 'currValExpr' of null(…) TypeError: Cannot read property 'currValExpr' of null
    at eval (http://localhost:5555/node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:12344:115)`

**Expected behavior**
<!-- Describe what the behavior would be without the bug. -->
Either a better error message like "Empty href bindings are not allowed" or update the code to allow it. For your reference this is line 12344 in angular 2.1.2 of compiler.umd.js

The function throwing the error is
`updateStmts.push.apply(updateStmts, writeToRenderer(THIS_EXPR, boundProp, renderNode, evalResult.currValExpr, view.genConfig.logBindingUpdate));`

#### Bug Report

1. Clone the repo.
2. Install latest angular-cli
3. Other necessary steps for setup
4. ng serve
5. Open http://localhost:4200
6. Browser just displays covalent loader message
7. Console shows  error message:
"Promise rejection: Cannot read property 'currValExpr' of null"


#### What is the expected behavior?
Browser should displays the covalent app

#### Which version of Angular and Material, and which browser and OS does this issue affect?
Angular 2.1.2
Chrome 54

Windows 7
Did this work in previous versions of Angular / Material?
Yes on 2.1.1

##### Other information
Workaround: New release is having the fix: (https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/12583)
Or, modified the src\app\components\components\directives\directives.component.html by assigning the value to  [hidden] attribute.
